Struct Fnv1aHashQuantizer

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Core
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Provides stable 64-bit FNV-1a hashing for quantized floating-point and Vector2 values.

public readonly struct Fnv1aHashQuantizer

Remarks

Values are first quantized through the configured DecimalQuantizer, then folded into an FNV-1a hash. This allows callers to generate deterministic hashes that ignore insignificant floating-point noise at the selected decimal precision.
